notes: Safe Merge Both Sides. Replaces dataset-level device-vs-cloud conflict choice for mergeable warehouse datasets with record-level union and reconciliation. Records present only on the phone/device are preserved; records present only in the cloud are restored locally; matching records are reconciled by stable record identity and latest timestamp while retaining nonblank older fields. Product Master, Product Inventory, Customer Orders, Special Orders, Operations, Cutting History, Carpet Inventory and other array datasets can be merged safely. Sync Now performs the safe merge before normal sync when mergeable conflicts exist. The old Keep Cloud / Keep This Device controls remain only as emergency manual overrides. No database schema change.
